# Cults3D test fixtures

`search.json` is original synthetic test data shaped after the official search,
design, and price examples linked from https://cults3d.com/en/pages/graphql to
https://gist.github.com/sunny/07db54478ac030bd277c19cfe734648b.

It is not a captured live response. Names, URLs, and images are fictitious;
do not present them as real results. No credentials, creator images, descriptions,
or model files are included. An authenticated response could not be captured
without an authorized user-supplied API key. Verify the current schema with
authorized access before claiming successful live search verification.
